bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches may enter after search; nonclear bags get extra screening. Large bags and backpacks are barred.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Fillmore does not own or operate public parking. Guests should use independently operated nearby lots or street spaces.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue allows passenger drop-off at the corner of Colfax Avenue and Clarkson Street. It does not publish a dedicated post-show rideshare pickup zone.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions are cashless and accept debit, credit and mobile payment. Outside food and beverages, including sealed and refillable water bottles, are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating can be purchased ahead of time for general admission shows; check with Guest Services at arrival for an escort. Some areas have stairs and are not wheelchair accessible.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Fillmore Auditorium does not permit re-entry after a guest leaves.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: All events use mobile tickets on a phone; tickets are not sent for printing. For phone issues, visit the event-day box office with ID; it opens three hours before doors.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors generally open one hour before showtime, and the time on a ticket is the door time. Metal-detector and bag screening apply at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
